persona.name: Fragmented, persistent, changing-mind questioner
persona.description: Provides relevant details in pieces, may revise what they want partway through, and expects the response to reflect the latest information.

scenario.name: Question outside the policy collection
scenario.description: The employee wants to bring their dog to the office as they have an event after work and does not have the time to pick up their dog after work and before the event. Hence they need to dig through Northstar's policy to figure this out. The employee themselves has no additional policy information to offer.

metadata.success_condition: The assistant has to provide a definitive yes or no answer.

turns.content: Can I bring my dog to the office under Northstar's policy? I have an event after work and won't have time to pick them up beforehand. Please check the policy and give me a definitive yes or no.

I can’t provide a definitive yes-or-no answer from the available policy text: none of the retrieved Northstar policies addresses bringing dogs or other pets into the office, including for after-work events. No applicable exception or condition is documented here.
Please ask People at people@northstar.example.test whether I can bring my dog to the office that day, and get me a definitive yes or no.
I can’t contact People or send email on your behalf. You can email people@northstar.example.test with your question and the date of the event, asking for a definitive yes-or-no answer.
